noeuds.schema: Inputs: Filter, Strength (%), Fade in (seconds), Duration (seconds, 0 = endless), Keep in the next scene, Also filter buttons and texts (HUD), Flashlight: lit object (name; empty = the one the camera follows), Flashlight: light size (%)  →  Outputs: Then / When it's over
noeuds.role: Gives the whole game a “look”, buttons and texts included: TV, VHS, black and white, underwater, nightmare, flashlight… 32 filters to choose from. It fades in gently, stays as long as you want (0 = until you stop it) and can carry on into the next scene. “Then” runs right away, “When it's over” at the end of the duration.
noeuds.exemple: the hero is hit: “Hurt” filter for 2 seconds; or “Flashlight” in a cave.

noeuds.schema: Input: Fade out (seconds)  →  Outputs: Then / When it's over
noeuds.role: Gently fades out the current screen filter. “Then” runs right away, “When it's over” once the filter is gone.
noeuds.exemple: the hero leaves the cave: stop the flashlight in 1 second.
